_note: Per-market grounding. The point of the exercise: the winning term in a market is not the translation of the English one. Volumes are recorded samples, labelled as such in the UI.

UK.note: Head term. Buyers search the ingredient, not the benefit.

SE.note: The literal translation 'vitamin c serum' gets 480 searches. Swedes compound the noun: c-vitaminserum wins 14 to 1. Translating the English term would target the wrong page.

DK.note: Danish splits where Swedish compounds. Same ingredient, different orthography, separate page needed.
